name: Muscat
tagline: Graceful Arabian capital of mosques, souks and wadis
summary: Muscat is the Gulf's most traditional capital, low-rise and white between rugged mountains and the sea. Visit the Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque, bargain for frankincense in the Mutrah Souq, stroll the corniche to Old Muscat's palace, and drive out to swim in the turquoise pools of Wadi Shab.
seasonNote: October to March is warm and sunny; summer is extremely hot.
arrival: Muscat International Airport is 25 minutes from Mutrah.
gettingAround: Taxis and Otaxi app; hire a car for wadis and Nizwa.
cashTip: Cards work widely; carry rials for souks, taxis and small cafés. A car is the best way to see the wadis.
foodTip: Shuwa, Omani halwa, mishkak skewers and karak tea.
baseArea: Mutrah, Qurum or Shatti Al Qurum
